positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Refactored and maintained PortBlocker, a cross-platform policy-based EDR solution to block or allow USB devices on a computer
- Built full-stack architecture: TypeScript/Node.js service layer, Electron frontend, and native system integrations handling USB, USB-C, and Thunderbolt device policies
- Implemented device detection and communication: VID/PID matching, certificate validation, and automated hardware-triggered application launching.
- Rebuilt legacy CI/CD pipeline from opaque Ant build system to modular GitHub Actions workflows, reducing build times from 20 minutes to 2-3 minutes with clear per-step visibility.
- Reduced application attack surface from 100+ vulnerable dependencies to 1 medium-severity issue through systematic auditing.
- Created internal developer tooling without specs: macOS CLI daemon controller (Swift), USB device simulator for remote testing on windows, and a one-command environment reset utility.
- Refactored codebase to allow for debugging when previously relied entirely on console logging alone.
- Maintained comprehensive documentation for projects, deployment processes, and developer onboarding.

- Engaged in IR&D efforts to create a robust interface with multiple CSPs.  
- Enhanced my expertise in full-stack development and cloud service integration.  
- Contributed to the overall success of the project by ensuring application reliability and performance.
